key_provisions_or_claims: Plans standardisation request on energy and resource efficiency of AI systems and GPAI models under AI Act Article 40, complementing M/613.
Cyber Resilience Act request covers gaps for machinery, lifts, agricultural machinery, rail and AI systems.
Revision of EN 4709 series and new standards for low-risk unmanned aircraft under Delegated Regulation 2019/945.
Lift standards addressing cybersafety and self-evolving AI behaviour, linked to the Machinery Regulation.
Dual-use civil-military standards mapping and gap analysis; anthropometric inclusiveness in machinery standards.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Notice setting the 2026 annual Union work programme for European standardisation, listing 43 actions for standardisation requests supporting EU legislation. Includes AI Act resource-efficiency standards, Cyber Resilience Act gaps for machinery and AI, drone standards, AI-related lift safety and dual-use mapping, within a competitiveness framing.
